proposedMessage.subject: Align Bodhi and Ṭhānissaro’s SN, AN and KN passages with the Pali
proposedMessage.body:
Improve the correspondence between the saved English translations and their
original Pali lines while preserving each translator’s wording and source
order. Separate independently rendered clauses, list items, refrains and
speaker introductions. Where English and Pali order differ, retain the
smallest coherent group instead of creating misleading individual matches.

Finding import and review:
- Preserve all 201 original input batches, returned findings and reader logs
  beside the review records: 89 Bodhi batches and 112 Ṭhānissaro batches.
- Verify that every imported log identifies gpt-6.1-sol at high reasoning
  effort, and that the inputs match the saved handoff byte for byte.
  Record archive and per-file hashes for reproducible provenance.
- Review all 489 initially passing groups against the original Pali:
  278 Bodhi groups and 211 Ṭhānissaro groups. Reject or repair the 36
  proposals that would worsen alignment, including false verse cuts based
  on Sujato’s different English order and misplaced compressed passages.
- Resolve applicable failed and disputed findings with named hand repairs.
  Preserve raw findings and comment superseded hand instructions so another
  session can follow the decisions. Save before/after group snapshots,
  judgments, exception rationales and cross-check dispositions.
- The Codex integration and its hand completions affect 674 Bodhi and 734
  Ṭhānissaro English segment rows before the fresh audit. These counts
  include both vacated and filled rows, rather than independent mistakes.

Grouped source ranges:
- Normalize a fully covered source span to its grouped Pali document when
  that document uses grouped keys. Preserve individually keyed AN batches
  and avoid claiming grouped documents only partly covered by a source.
- Restore Ṭhānissaro’s SN45.57–61, SN56.105–107, SN56.108–110 and
  SN56.111–113 documents, which the expanded individual IDs skipped.
  Place dawn/accomplishment variants and human/deva rebirth comparisons
  on their corresponding Pali documents; remove obsolete saved anchors.
- Add three regression tests using the real saved sources for rebirth
  destinations, path-accomplishment variants and separately keyed AN texts.

Independent audit and follow-up:
- Preserve fresh audit5 draws, frozen comparison batches with the original
  Pali supplied on every row, independent reader coverage, findings and
  reviewed repairs. Read 2,482 Bodhi rows and 2,504 Ṭhānissaro rows,
  excluding texts drawn in earlier audits.
- Apply 46 Bodhi and 58 Ṭhānissaro audit boundary corrections. The rates
  before those repairs are Bodhi SN 2.99% and AN 0.72%; Ṭhānissaro
  SN 1.16%, AN 1.61% and KN 4.18%. Bodhi has no eligible fresh KN text.
  Record that these exceed the approximate 0.5% benchmark and do not
  certify the unreviewed remainder of the corpus.
- Repeat cross-check and list rounds in new folders until no new suspects
  remain, judging candidates against Pali rather than restoring a cut
  solely because Sujato’s English suggests it.
- Including audit and follow-up repairs, the integration affects 755 Bodhi
  and 830 Ṭhānissaro English segment rows, with 490 and 592 changed
  stored cut decisions respectively.

Validation and handoff:
- Check all 1,166 Bodhi and 1,433 Ṭhānissaro source pages: zero word
  differences and zero integrity problems for both translators.
- Rebuild from saved decisions and compare all 3,854 translation data
  files byte for byte: identical output. All three source-range regression
  tests pass. Edited code and data pass the whitespace check; archived
  review inputs retain their original formatting and hashes.
- Consolidate completed work and remaining limitations in the repository.
  Explicitly record Bodhi’s duplicate SN45 range/terminal sources,
  Ṭhānissaro’s legacy AN numbering and source precedence, source-edition
  differences, and compressed passages requiring noncontiguous coverage.
  These source/correspondence cases remain deferred rather than being
  presented as resolved by ordinary boundary cuts.
- Record future Pali reveal and correspondence requirements in the existing
  upstream README app section. Preserve the proposal for stronger direct
  Pali reads and line-weighted audits without changing the review process.
- Leave app implementation, Sujato/Pali data, completed MN/DN translations,
  prepared MN/DN round12, and the unfinished recovered verse workflow
  outside this change.
